adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-255 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (absent), the code falls back to searching destinationCalendar for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` - but externalCalendarId is undefined/null at this point, so the find will never match anything. This is a logical bug that would cause selectedCalendar to be undefined when externalCalendarId is not provided, breaking legacy calendar updates.
